design.design_status: frozen after the registered event study returned insufficient_events and before any continuous-test estimate was computed
design.motivation: The registered event-study estimand was sample-starved by construction. This is a new estimand, chosen because the old test did not execute, not because its results were unfavourable.

sample.quote_convention: USD per foreign-currency unit; positive returns are foreign-currency appreciation

estimator.point: minimum-distance J on the eligible discrete grid
estimator.banks: pair-specific banks and frozen nuisance scales from the registered FX event study

primary.estimand: b in forward_stress = a + b * J_hat + c * log(current_realized_volatility) + error

negative_control.pipeline: identical dates, rolling estimator, forward outcomes, regression and block bootstrap

presentation.interpretation: Intervals are expected to be wide because overlapping 500-session predictors are persistent despite non-overlapping forward outcomes. If b is near zero, report that the statistic adds nothing beyond volatility clustering.
